purpose: Teach: 椎/蕾/唾/皺/両端/左折/８つ/スギ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、林間学校で椎茸狩りしてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were picking shiitakes at forest school, weren't you.
lines.style: Light, knowing jab. Opens easy and warm. Quick pace, familiar rhythm of teasing someone. Eyes bright with the pleasure of catching them in something small.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、桜の蕾の写真撮ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one photographing cherry blossoms, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft counter. Not defensive — just turning the mirror back. Steady eye contact. A small smile in the voice, not unkind. Pace even, almost conversational.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、話す時に唾飛ばすって言われたろ
lines.en: Riku — people told you that you spit when you talk, didn't they.
lines.style: Sharper edge now, but still playful. A bite underneath. Raised tempo. Leans into the embarrassment of it, enjoying the discomfort with affection underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、制服のスカートの皺気にしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were worried about the wrinkles in your uniform skirt, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick parry. Matter-of-fact, almost deadpan. Neutral pace. No heat — just stating the obvious with the lightest smile. Doesn't labour the point.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、答案用紙の両端に落書きしてたろ
lines.en: Riku — you had doodles all over the sides of your test paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Building momentum now. Brighter, almost triumphant. Pace picks up slightly. Voice carries the satisfaction of another perfect counter. Riding the rhythm of the exchange.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自転車で左折ウインカー忘れたろ、桜
lines.en: You forgot to signal a left turn on your bike, Sakura.
lines.style: Lands it evenly. Cool, unruffled. Slight rise at the end — not a question, just the natural arc of someone making their point stick. Brief pause before the name for effect.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で旅館の朝食８つの小鉢食べたな
lines.en: Riku — you ate all eight of those little dishes at the ryokan breakfast with your family.
lines.style: Shift in tone — warmer now, less biting. Almost affectionate observation. Opens with curiosity instead of attack. Pace gentles. A smile underneath, not mocking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、スギ花粉の季節辛そうだったな、桜
lines.en: You looked pretty rough during cedar pollen season, Sakura.
lines.style: Closes gently. No edge now — just noticing, with a soft kind of care. Quiet delivery. Pace slows. The teasing has become something quieter: I notice when you're struggling.
